docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The journal of the summer of 1869, when Muir went up into the Sierra Nevada with a flock of sheep and a shepherd and wrote day by day of the glaciers, forests, flowers, animals and weather of the high country, with the photographs and drawings of the first edition.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

John Muir (1838–1914), My First Summer in the Sierra, 1911. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
